prompt_template: A cinematic shot of a futuristic city at night

nodeInfoList.fieldValue: A cinematic shot of a futuristic city at night
nodeInfoList.llmHint: 用英文描述整个视频场景。例："A cinematic shot of a futuristic city at night, with neon lights reflecting on wet streets"
nodeInfoList.example: A cinematic shot of a futuristic city at night, with neon lights reflecting on wet streets

description: 基于 LTX Director 模型的文本驱动视频生成

call_guide.method: runninghub run <ID> --type workflow --node '46:global_prompt=<场景提示词>' [--node '46:duration_seconds=<秒>'] [--node '46:frame_rate=<帧率>']

required.label: 全局场景提示词
required.hint: 描述整个视频的场景、画面、镜头语言。例：'A cinematic shot of a medieval knight walking through a misty forest, dolly zoom effect, dramatic lighting'

examples.title: 导演模式
examples.command: runninghub run 2059132036383858689 --type workflow --node '46:global_prompt=A cinematic shot of a knight walking through misty forest, dramatic lighting, volumetric fog, epic slow motion'
examples.description: LTX Director 用导演视角生成视频

examples.title: 指定参数
examples.command: runninghub run 2059132036383858689 --type workflow --node '46:global_prompt=A beautiful dancer performing on stage, spotlight, slow graceful movements, cinematic' --node '46:duration_seconds=10' --node '46:frame_rate=30'

tips: 提示词建议包含镜头运动描述（推/拉/摇/移）
帧率越高视频越流畅但生成时间增加
